name: SitePulse – See What’s Powering (or Slowing) Your Site
author: Nilbug

sections.description:
SitePulse helps you understand what powers (or slows down) your site — directly from your WordPress dashboard.
You’ll instantly see load-time metrics, slow hooks, and plugin usage so you can keep your site optimized without extra tools.

🚀 Key Features

  • Real-time load time tracker – See how long each page takes to load.
  • Slow plugin & hook profiler – Detect which plugin or hook is causing bottlenecks.
  • Uptime & API monitoring – Verify your site’s health and response codes automatically.
  • Lightweight & privacy-friendly – Runs locally, with minimal overhead and no data sharing.
  • Dashboard insights – View charts, trends, and logs from your WordPress admin.
  • Exportable logs – Download CSV logs for deeper analysis or reporting.

💡 Why Choose SitePulse?

Most performance plugins optimize — SitePulse helps you understand.
Before you install another caching or optimization tool, find out what’s really slowing your site down — themes, plugins, queries, or hooks — with clear data and no guesswork.

Support

Having trouble or have suggestions?
→ Visit the SitePulse Support Forum or open an issue on GitHub.
We respond quickly and love feedback that helps improve performance visibility for everyone.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sitepulse folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate SitePulse from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the SitePulse → Dashboard menu to view metrics and configure options.
  4. (Optional) Set up scheduled checks using WP-Cron or your hosting panel’s cron jobs.
sections.faq:
Does SitePulse slow my site down?

No. SitePulse is built to be lightweight and runs asynchronously. Profiling is optional and can be toggled off anytime.

Do I need external services?

No external accounts are required. SitePulse runs 100% inside WordPress and uses the WP REST API for internal checks.

Can it work with WooCommerce or multisite?

Yes. SitePulse tracks any page or post type, including WooCommerce product pages and multisite environments.

Can I export performance data?

Yes. You can export logs and hook profiles for backup or to analyze on your local computer.
